body.name: Pole-aware Möbius and singular-clause normalization
body.construction: For each relation \(a x y+b x+c y+d=0\), use the matrix \(M=\left(\begin{smallmatrix}a&b\\c&d\end{smallmatrix}\right)\). Join variables when \(\det M\ne0\), compose the exact fractional-linear maps while recording their poles, substitute into all internal relations, and define \(D_C\) by the real roots of their degree-at-most-two greatest common divisor with every recorded pole removed. Factor every rank-one relation as \((u x+v)(w y+z)=0\), translate it into an equality disjunction across components, and conjoin domain coverage and pairwise-exclusion clauses to form \(\Psi(G,\Sigma)\).
